## Notes

Endless goal lines after milestones and jobs; cost grows exponentially per level (Fluids & Painting starts at 15,000 shapes with 18% growth); levels reward Platform Units, Blueprint Points, and Research Points unless copy/paste is free or the platform limit is off.
